title: David and the Murderers of Ishbosheth
reflectionText: Rechab and Baanah brought Ishbosheth’s head to David and spoke of vengeance. David answered by naming a righteous man killed in his own house upon his bed. How do you hear their claim beside David’s answer, before the account closes with punishment and burial in Hebron?
